select count(*) from
(select orgunit_id, 
customer_id,
salesforce_id,
user_id,
count(actual_SOA_SENT) as actual_SOA_SENT_cnt,
count(Veeva_SOA_SENT) as Veeva_SOA_SENT_cnt
from (
SELECT   A.orgunit_id
		,A.customer_id
		,upper(A.salesforce_id) AS salesforce_id
		,A.user_id
		,A.SOA_SENT as actual_SOA_SENT
		,max(CASE 
			WHEN B.SOA_SENT IS NULL
				OR B.SOA_SENT = 0
				THEN 0
			ELSE B.SOA_SENT
			END) AS Veeva_SOA_SENT
	FROM 
	(select  a.orgunit_id,	a.product_id,	a.customer_id,	a.salesforce_id,	a.user_id,
a.SOA_SENT, cast(b.end_date as date) as activty_date from src as a
left join
timedata as b on a.time_id=b.time_id
) A
INNER JOIN
  ( SELECT lilly_person_id AS hcp_id ,
           B.product_id_m_prod ,
           max(CASE
                   WHEN upper(channel) = 'SOA_ENGAGED' THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS SOA_ENGAGED ,
           NULL AS P2P ,
           max(CASE
                   WHEN upper(channel) = 'HQ_EMAIL_ENGAGED' THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS HQ_EMAIL_ENGAGED ,
           max(CASE
                   WHEN upper(channel) = 'SOA_SENT' THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS SOA_SENT,
           max(CASE
                   WHEN upper(channel) = 'HQ_EMAIL_SENT' THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS HQ_EMAIL_SENT
   FROM
     ( SELECT A.* ,
              m_prod.attr_val AS product_id_m_prod
      FROM
(
SELECT lilly_person_id ,
                      BRND_EMAIL.indctn AS indication_id ,
                      actvy_dt AS activity_date ,
                      CASE
                          WHEN upper(BRND_EMAIL.data_src_cd) IN ('SFMC',
                                                                 'HIBBERT')
                               AND upper(BRND_EMAIL.platform) IN ('SK&A',
                                                                  'LILLY SFMC',
                                                                  'HEALTHLINK SFMC') THEN 'HQ_EMAIL_SENT'
                          WHEN upper(BRND_EMAIL.data_src_cd) IN ('DOXIMITY',
                                                                 'MEDSCAPE',
                                                                 'EPOCRATES',
                                                                 'DOXIMITY')
                               AND upper(BRND_EMAIL.platform) IN ('DOCNEWS ALERT',
                                                                  'BRAND ALERT',
                                                                  'EMAIL',
                                                                  'POINT OF CONTACT',
                                                                  'POC',
                                                                  'DOCALERT') THEN 'SOA_SENT'
                          ELSE 'NA'
                      END AS channel ,
                      msg_type AS message_type ,
                      CASE
                          WHEN upper(BRND_EMAIL.data_src_cd) IN ('SFMC',
                                                                 'HIBBERT') THEN concat("titled ",max(tactic_description),".")
                      END AS HQ_TACTIC_TITLE_SENT ,
                      CASE
                          WHEN upper(BRND_EMAIL.data_src_cd) NOT IN ('SFMC',
                                                                     'HIBBERT') THEN concat("on ",max(primary_category),".")
                      END AS CONTENT_CATEGORY_SENT ,
                      NULL AS HQ_TACTIC_TITLE_ENGAGED ,
                      NULL AS CONTENT_CATEGORY_ENGAGED ,
                      NULL AS topic
         FROM BRAND_SENT_EMAILS BRND_EMAIL
         LEFT JOIN cap_extract CAP ON tactic_id = CAP.verso_tactic_id
         WHERE ( upper(actvy_data_type) LIKE '%IMPRESSIONS%'
                OR upper(actvy_data_type) LIKE '%DELIVERED_EM%'
                OR upper(actvy_data_type) LIKE '%VIEWS_HEADLINE%'
                OR upper(actvy_data_type) LIKE '%DELIVERED_AL%'
                OR upper(actvy_data_type) LIKE '%SENT%')
           AND upper(actvy_type) LIKE '%IMPRESSION%'
           AND lilly_person_id IS NOT NULL
         GROUP BY lilly_person_id ,
                  actvy_dt ,
                  BRND_EMAIL.data_src_cd ,
                  BRND_EMAIL.platform ,
                  msg_type ,
                  BRND_EMAIL.indctn ) A
      INNER JOIN
        (SELECT attr_val,
                src_prod_nm
         FROM M_PROD_XREF
         WHERE src_nm ='SOA_ACTIVITY_FI') m_prod
		 ON m_prod.src_prod_nm = upper(A.indication_id)
		  WHERE A.channel <> 'NA' 
		  ) B
   GROUP BY lilly_person_id ,
            product_id_m_prod ) B ON A.customer_id = B.hcp_id
AND upper(B.product_id_m_prod) = upper(A.product_id)

 

group by A.orgunit_id,A.customer_id,upper(A.salesforce_id),A.user_id,A.SOA_sent
        ) M
        group by orgunit_id, customer_id,salesforce_id,user_id
        having count(actual_soa_sent) != count(veeva_soa_sent)
) m
